description.value: Fat Mao is a modern Thai-style noodle bar by acclaimed Vancouver chef Angus An, inspired by small family-run storefronts that specialize in perfecting a single dish over generations. The 25-seat open-kitchen Downtown location focuses on regional Thai noodle soups such as Khao Soi, Nham Ngeaw, and Tom Yum Goong, alongside small plates drawing on Southeast Asian and Sichuanese flavours. It is one of two Fat Mao locations in Vancouver, with a sister restaurant in Chinatown.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record targets the Downtown location at 983 Helmcken St, which the website corroborates with matching address and phone (604-801-5088). Vegetarian options are confirmed by both OSM (diet:vegetarian=yes) and the website (e.g., 'Vegetarian Cauliflower and Tofu Khao Soi Curry', 'Vegetarian Available' notation on Roti). Takeout is confirmed by the website's explicit mention of takeout bag fees under the Vancouver single-use bylaw and references to DoorDash/UberEats pickup; bike parking, washrooms, and most cycling amenities are not mentioned anywhere in the website content or OSM tags.
concerns: The website's global header/front-page canonical address displays the Chinatown location (217 E Georgia St, V6A 1Z6) rather than the Downtown location this OSM node represents; the Downtown address is correctly listed in the location-specific section of the site.
No bike parking information found on website or in OSM tags — a key WWC criterion remains unverified.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A legitimate, active full-service restaurant with vegetarian options and takeout, conveniently located in central Vancouver — a solid stop for touring cyclists passing through the downtown core.
